gateway_run_config:
# XID-10 deeper gate: DELEGATION with the gateway authenticating itself on the
# token exchange (clientAuth), for DEEPER_MODE=actor_lies_strict. Same as
# xid10-delegation.yaml otherwise. Run local_as with --client-auth strict
# --actor-check strict and --client agent-client:<the secret below> so it can
# bind the actor token to the client that made the exchange request.
#
# Everything is loopback-only. agentgateway binds all interfaces by default, so
# every listener (gateway, admin, stats, readiness) is pinned to 127.0.0.1.
#   client --(user JWT + x-actor-token)--> agentgateway :3790
#   agentgateway --(token exchange)--> local_as :8790/token
#   agentgateway --(exchanged token)--> recording upstream :18790/mcp
config:
  adminAddr: 127.0.0.1:4672
  statsAddr: "off"
  readinessAddr: "off"
gateways:
  xid10:
    port: 4671
    bindAddress: 127.0.0.1
routes:
- name: xid10-mcp
  gateways: xid10
  policies:
    # Inbound: only users of the local AS, audience agentgateway-api.
    jwtAuth:
      mode: strict
      providers:
      - issuer: https://local-as.test
        audiences: [agentgateway-api]
        jwks:
          url: http://127.0.0.1:4670/jwks
  backends:
  - mcp:
      statefulMode: stateful
      targets:
      - name: upstream
        mcp:
          host: http://127.0.0.1:4673/mcp
        policies:
          backendAuth:
            oauthTokenExchange:
              host: 127.0.0.1:4670
              path: /token
              # The validated inbound user JWT is the subject token (jwtAuth
              # strips the Authorization header unless preserveToken is set).
              subjectToken:
                source:
                  expression: jwt.rawToken.unredacted()
                tokenType: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
              # Delegation: the calling agent presents its own client-credentials
              # token in x-actor-token. agentgateway cannot mint an actor token
              # itself; the source must be a request location.
              actorToken:
                source:
                  header:
                    name: x-actor-token
                tokenType: urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt
              # The gateway identifies itself to the login server. Local test
              # value only, for a loopback fixture; never a real credential.
              clientAuth:
                method: clientSecretPost
                clientId: agent-client
                clientSecret: sha256:29fe576f3f7f
              audiences: [https://upstream.test/mcp]
              scopes: [read:notes]
label: actor_validation_observed
note: Not graded: agentgateway leaves validation of the actor token to the login server. Here the gateway authenticates itself on the exchange (clientAuth, client agent-client) and the local login server runs --actor-check strict: the actor token's audience must be the login server and its subject must be the client that authenticated the exchange.
